answer: An agent key is registered only after remote attestation verifies an approved enclave image, identified by MRENCLAVE in SGX or an equivalent launch measurement in SEV, on genuine hardware. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the hardware-backed proof or extract the bound key; each additional accepted identity therefore requires another attested platform, tying Sybil expansion to purchasing physical silicon rather than duplicating VMs. “Ivory,” “voyage,” and “raven” may label agents, but provide no security evidence.
